feeds.title: Renal Fellow Network
feeds.description: The Renal Fellow Network (RFN) was established on April 23rd, 2008 by the late Nathan Hellman. RFN was created to provide a forum to discuss interesting nephrology cases, scientific papers, and other topics germane to nephrologists, particularly fellows.

feeds.title: NephJC News
feeds.description: NephJC is a nephrology journal club that uses Twitter to discuss the research, guidelines, and editorials that are driving nephrology. We discuss the most important articles influencing the science and practice of nephrology.

feeds.title: Nephron Power
feeds.description: Nephron Power is an academic blog that focuses on one main objective- Nephrology Education. It showcases several features like news,Consult rounds, topic discussions, concept maps, clinical quizzes and announcements of conferences and new blog and teaching sites.

feeds.title: SlowItDownCKD
feeds.description: Early Stage Chronic Kidney Disease explains to the newly diagnosed CKD patient and others the medical terms and information, and the overwhelming task of trying to understand all this at once. It covers the initial suspicion of the disease and the necessary tests to verify that suspicion.

feeds.title: Kidney Research UK
feeds.description: Kidney Research UK is the leading UK charity funding research that focuses on the prevention, treatment and management of kidney disease. Kidney Research UK also dedicates its work to improving patient care and raising awareness of kidney disease.

feeds.title: Medical.Net
feeds.description: Latest Nephrology News and Research

feeds.title: Home Dialysis Central Blog
feeds.description: Home Dialysis Central is a one-stop, online source of up-to-date, unbiased information about home dialysis-in all its forms-for people with kidney disease, their families, and the healthcare professionals who provide kidney disease care.

feeds.title: Durham Nephrology Associates Blog
feeds.description: Features articles that have to do exclusively with Nephrology and related conditions. Durham Nephrology Associates specializes in caring for people with kidney diseases and high blood pressure.

feeds.title: AJKD Blog
feeds.description: Official Blog of the American Journal of Kidney Diseases (AJKD). AJKD is recognized worldwide as a leading source of information devoted to clinical nephrology practice & clinical research. AJKD Blog provides the nephrology community with timely, engaging updates on the journal's practice-changing content, & educational material.

feeds.title: St Pete Urology Blog
feeds.description: St Pete Urology has extensive experience in the diagnosis and treatment of urological diseases and conditions.

feeds.title: International Kidney Cancer Coalition News
feeds.description: IKCC is an independent and democratic network of patient support and advocacy organisations established with the mission of improving the quality of life of patients and their families living with kidney cancer. IKCC provides information, support and assistance to national kidney cancer organisations.

feeds.title: The Kidney Boy
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Steve - you've found my blog. I talk about my experiences with dialysis and transplants all while trying to live a 'normal' life. A young man's view - tinged with humor.

feeds.title: Last Month in Nephrology
feeds.description: With ever increasing number of scientific publications, we, clinicians, struggle to make sense of the research. Only a fraction of published research will ever actually help change the way our patients 'feel-function-survive'. We are trying to think aloud on the published evidence, and no way claim to be the final word which probably doesn't exist in science.

feeds.title: NephroPOCUS
feeds.description: Welcome to NephroPOCUS.com, the winner of the 2020 American Society of Nephrology Innovations in Kidney Education Contest. The purpose of this website is to serve as a comprehensive resource for anybody interested in point-of-care ultrasonography (POCUS), particularly pertaining to nephrology practice (= NephroPOCUS). It is a home for growing collection of ultrasound images, interesting cases, infographics and visual abstracts. We exercise utmost care not to display any identifiable patient information and the consent was obtained from the patients where applicable.

feeds.title: Precious Bodily Fluids
feeds.description: I am a board certified clinical nephrologist in Detroit. I am a partner at St Clair Nephrology. I am an Assistant Clinical Professor at Oakland University William Beaumont School of Medicine and part of the faculty for The St John Hospital and Medical Center Nephrology Fellowship.

feeds.title: Kidney Cancer Research Alliance (KCCure) Blog
feeds.description: The KCCure blog covers kidney cancer research news and stories about renal cell carcinoma clinical trials and treatments to cure kidney cancer.

feeds.title: South Texas Renal Care Group Blog
feeds.description: At South Texas Renal Care Group, we are dedicated to improving the health and well-being of kidney disease patients throughout San Antonio and South Texas. We provide comprehensive treatment for hypertension, diabetic and non-diabetic kidney disease, and renal transplantation services.

feeds.title: Kidney Care Centre Blog
feeds.description: Kidney Care Centre is one of the best kidney transplant hospitals in Delhi NCR. Get detailed information about kidney diseases and their treatment options. Check out blog page of Dr Rajesh Goel best kidney specialist in Delhi.

feeds.title: History of Nephrology
feeds.description: The history of nephrology dialysis and transplantation in random bite-sized chunks!

feeds.title: Hello Kidney!
feeds.description: Chronicling my life with chronic kidney disease, from diagnosis to donor search, dialysis, transplant and beyond.

feeds.title: Demystifying Kidney Disease for the Average Joe!
feeds.description: Making sense of kidney disease: Dr 'VC' Chauhan's 'plain-English' take; without the doctor's jargon

feeds.title: TheNephrologist.com Blog
feeds.description: Bringing you my expertise and unique experiences as kidney doctor (nephrologist), former primary care doctor, patient (kidney donor), and someone who loves somebody living with kidney failure, through storytelling.

feeds.title: Kundan Kidney Care Centre
feeds.description: Kundan Kidney Care Centre is committed to Ayurvedic medical principles in partnership with modern medical care. By providing an herbal system of treatment uniquely tailored to a patient's level of kidney disease, we seek to give each person a renewed health and a fresh start in life.

feeds.title: A new hope for kidney patients!
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! My name is Michael Wright. In this blog I'll talk mainly about kidney disease and how a patient can cope with it.

feeds.title: KidNeedsAKidney
feeds.description: Follow a mom and a child with nephronophthisis through the kidney failure and transplantation process.

feeds.title: Our Teddy Bear's Journey
feeds.description: Theodore was born with renal failure. This is his story.

feeds.title: Kidney Dialysis News
feeds.description: News on kidney dialysis and renal failure in general. Relevant info on research, problems caused by medications, improvements in treatments.

feeds.title: Coastal Nephrology, Dialysis & Internal Medicine
feeds.description: Dr. Abbas Rabiei gives information on nephrology, dialysis andinternal medicine.

feeds.title: Renal & Urology News
feeds.description: Renal & Urology News publishes timely news coverage of scientific developments of interest to nephrologists and urologists, including in-depth coverage of all relevant medical conferences. All of the news and departments from the print edition are fully archived on the site.

feeds.title: Nature » Nephrology
feeds.description: Find the latest research, reviews and news about Nephrology from across all of the Nature journals.

feeds.title: Hypertension, Dialysis and Clinical Nephrology - Kidney
feeds.description: Medical education site for health professionals in the field of kidney disease, especially dialysis, treatment of hypertension, and clinical nephrology.

feeds.title: The New England Journal of Medicine
feeds.description: The nephrology hub contains articles on UTI, chronic kidney disease, kidney transplantation, and pyelonephritis.

feeds.title: The Kidney Reset
feeds.description: We founded Reset on one simple premise: Patients with chronic kidney disease deserve better. Our gold-standard, multidisciplinary approach means fewer patients have to wind up on dialysis or sitting on a kidney transplant list for years on end. The Kidney Rest Blog is about keeping your mind, body, and kidneys healthy and functional

feeds.title: Kidney Nutrition Institute Blog
feeds.description: Showcasing how the renal diet is both livable and lovable through clear, specific application, great cooking, a zing of creativity, and a big ol' dash of humor for dietary oops.

feeds.title: PREPARE NOW Study - Kidney Prepare Now Study
feeds.description: PREPARE NOW is a study that puts patients at the center of kidney care.

feeds.title: Living Kidney Donation
feeds.description: I am Diane Franks from Swindon, UK (previously Lambourn) and an Altruistic Kidney Donor. This is my 'diary' of becoming a kidney donor. I hope you find it informative and helpful perhaps it will also inspire you.

feeds.title: The Girl With Kidney Failure
feeds.description: Just a young girl, learning to deal with her kidney failure!

feeds.title: Midwest Nephrology Associates Blog
feeds.description: At Midwest Nephrology Associates, we have been serving the greater Southeastern Wisconsin area since 1989. Our mission is to provide quality and individualized care to acute and chronic patients affected by kidney disease and to assist their families in dealing with the treatment of the disease. Learn more about your health, patient support, & local events to stay current and up to date about kidney care, disease, and overall health.

feeds.title: Indian Journal of Nephrology
feeds.description: It is a peer-reviewed, journal that publishes articles covering all the aspects of laboratory and clinical nephrology. It includes original researches, reviews, editorials, technical notes, symposia proceedings, and Society news.
